resources.string: Choose a code type before saving.
Cheat code types are available for Game Boy, Game Boy Color, and Game Boy Advance games.
GameShark needs 8 hexadecimal digits per code, for example 01A2B3C4. Enter up to 8 lines, with 24 characters per trimmed line.
Game Genie needs 6 or 9 hexadecimal digits after removing dashes, for example ABC-DEF or ABC-DEF-012. Enter up to 8 lines, with 24 characters per trimmed line.
GBA GameShark needs two 8-digit hexadecimal groups, for example 01234567 89ABCDEF. Enter up to 8 lines, with 24 characters per trimmed line.
Action Replay needs two 8-digit hexadecimal groups, for example 01234567 89ABCDEF. Enter up to 8 lines, with 24 characters per trimmed line.
CodeBreaker needs an 8-digit group and a 4-digit group, for example 32028642 00FE. Enter up to 8 lines, with 24 characters per trimmed line.
Some GBA games require the master/enable code as the first line.
